SELECT cgca.id AS id, cgca.is_mandatory AS is_mandatory, cgca.deadline AS deadline, cgca.created_date AS created_date, cgca.modified_date AS modified_date, , ,
FROM gc_content_group_course_assignment cgca JOIN courses s ON cgca.course_id = s.id JOIN gc_access a ON cgca.content_group_id = a.id LEFT JOIN gc_user u ON cgca.created_by_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info ui ON u.info_id = ui.id LEFT JOIN sys_file sfs ON sfs.ID = s.sub_img_id LEFT JOIN sys_file sfui ON sfui.ID = ui.avatar_file_id WHERE cgca.content_group_id = #{contentGroupId}

SELECT id AS id, course_id AS course_id, content_group_id AS content_group_id, created_by_user_id AS created_by_user_id, is_mandatory AS is_mandatory, deadline AS deadline, created_date AS created_date, modified_date AS modified_date FROM gc_content_group_course_assignment WHERE content_group_id = #{contentGroupId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
